title: Someone Found a Way to Run Claude Code Completely Free Using NVIDIA's API
description:
40 requests per minute. Zero cost. Full Claude Code experience in your terminal.

It's called Free Claude Code — and here's exactly how it works:

NVIDIA has a platform called NIM that lets you run powerful AI models through their API for free. This project builds a lightweight proxy that sits between Claude Code and NVIDIA NIM — so Claude Code thinks it's talking to Anthropic's servers, but it's actually hitting NVIDIA's free API instead.

✅ Full Claude Code experience in your terminal
✅ 40 requests per minute at $0
✅ Supports dozens of models including Kimi K2, Minimax, and more
✅ Connect it to a Telegram bot and send tasks from your phone — watch Claude Code work on them autonomously from anywhere
✅ 2 commands to set up. That's it.

Comment "free" and I'll DM you the link 👇
